name: webagent
description: Give your coding agent a cloud browser: run web tasks (research, forms, scrape, monitor) and test your app, with webagent's MCP tools, /webagent:run, /webagent:engines, /webagent:qa, /webagent:qa-triage, /webagent:qa-init and /webagent:qa-ci. Sign in with Lookover in the browser; no API key needed.

api_key.title: webagent API key (optional)
api_key.description: Optional, for CI / no browser; leave empty to sign in with Lookover (/mcp, plugin:webagent:webagent, Authenticate). A key from the dashboard (API keys, Create key; member role is enough) looks like wa_<region>_... Stored in your system keychain, never in a file.

api_url.title: webagent API URL
api_url.description: API origin without /mcp. Keep the default unless your team gave you another (beta: this is the staging host).
